subject: alt-d
title: ALT.D.------ALT.F.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 90 (CS-18). ALT-D (alternative definitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; the second title code, ALT-F (alternative functionalism), is not drawn as a label, and the main line runs to TRS (transition), the third title code. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree), EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions); AFI-2 and EXP-DYM carry the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From AFI-2: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From AF-DY: INT (intention). From INT: INFO-F (information focus), with the (R) prefix. LANG-DY (language dynamics) is on a dotted line from INT.
